primary_definition: unweighted mean of four target mean-part IoUs, Face uses the shared tight GT Face bbox scoring domain

GT.parts: union source components with the same image-local owner and class
GT.valid: whole original grid except shared explicit ignore, under50 boxes, class/owner conflicts, degenerate-shape raster pixels and the previously reviewed class-error shape
GT.Hair_Upper_Lower: compare the matched person's prediction against that person's positive GT part on the full shared valid grid
GT.Face_local: compare within the tight pixel bbox of the positive GT Face mask, no margin, intersect shared valid grid
GT.reference_assumption: each accepted positive part mask specifies the visible reference extent of that part for its owner
GT.unassigned: retained as source unassigned. Within a positive-person-part task, pixels outside that person's reference part are non-target. No full-scene semantic background certification is inferred
GT.absent_part_annotation: no task for that owner and class
GT.missed_GT_person: empty prediction, positive parts remain in denominator with IoU zero

matching.type: frozen CCTV600 GT-first confidence-ordered bbox matching
matching.difference_from_reference: CCTV600 has bbox GT without full-person silhouette masks. Uses bbox IoU, not the earlier GT-person-mask matcher
matching.tie: confidence, predicted box geometry, maximum eligible GT IoU then GT box geometry. Identical geometry uses source order and is reported

mapping: reuse CIHP_SAPIENS_COMMON_VIEW_REVISION2 total native20/native29 mapping, Face ID1 Hair ID2 Upper ID3 Lower ID4 in the reference scorer
projection: per-person native hard planes after the existing YOLO ownership route. All native classes preserved. No global semantic composition is used as a substitute for per-person part scoring
garments: CIHP UpperClothes+Coat and Pants+Skirt, Sapiens Upper_Clothing and Lower_Clothing. Dress/Apparel remain OTHER. No geometric split
Face_claim: agreement within GT Face bbox under Face/Face_Neck proxy mapping. Does not establish full-frame face-only or neck quality
STRICT_COMPLETE: 600 exact unique image IDs, all frozen original detector ROI jobs accepted with complete source bindings. Incomplete primary null, historical failures retained
native_inference: reuse accepted RGB-crop native predictions. Process only missing ROI jobs in fresh linked collections. FP32/batch1/preprocessing/TTA/thresholds/checkpoints/YOLO ownership remain bound to the accepted collector

repairs.RPR: accept a native empty BoxList as an empty prediction only when the parsing-field KeyError traceback proves len(pred)==0. Unexpected nonempty missing-field outputs fail
repairs.CPI_unused_cache_guard: if physical free VRAM is below the existing guard, release this process's unused PyTorch cache once before rechecking the guard. No model retry, allocator environment change, precision or resolution change

timing: record accepted per-ROI adapter intervals, sum actual ROI work per image and population. Preserve source interval scope, failures, warmups and missing timer reasons. Dedicated 100-image x3 rounds keep the previous clean-resource policy
scope_end: stop after the approved nine checkpoints and their scheduled timing rounds
